title: Clear CI cache for the CI workflow
body: Go to GitHub Actions > CI workflow > click ⋮ > 'Clear cache', then re-run the workflow. The ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @/ path aliases is an environmental issue — pnpm store cache in the CI runner is stale/inconsistent with the lockfile.
rationale: Local tests pass cleanly (199 files, 2520 tests, typecheck pass, lint pass). The CI failure is not a code problem.
